feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: New revelations in Cornell sexual assault case spark outrage
entry.summary: The alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR — counter to what a prosecutor has claimed.

entry.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
entry.summary: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

entry.title: A judge permanently dismisses former Olympian's Reflecting Pool charges
entry.summary: Citing "exceptional circumstances," a D.C. judge has ruled that the federal government cannot refile its Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn, despite pressure from President Trump to do so.

entry.title: AI data centers: How much are ratepayers on the hook for?
entry.summary: Data centers consume large amounts of power and require upgrading infrastructure. But it's difficult to determine how much residential customers benefit and how much they actually pay for the benefit.

entry.title: Cornell Jane Doe's attorney says she told police in 2024: 'I was raped'
entry.summary: Counter to what a local prosecutor has claimed, the alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR.

entry.title: Tennessee halts executions after woman survives lethal injection
entry.summary: Christa Gail Pike was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder and was supposed to be executed Wednesday night. But after two lethal injections, she was still alive.

entry.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
entry.summary: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

entry.title: Trump administration reverses stance on integration of people with disabilities
entry.summary: Disability rights advocates are angered by the latest reversal but are rallying behind proposed legislation and working with states to strengthen protections for community integration.

entry.title: Studying this super El Niño could save lives. NOAA is scaling back research
entry.summary: A powerful El Niño is already influencing extreme weather around the planet. During the last strong El Niño, federal agencies ramped up research in the hope of improving weather forecasts. This year, they won't be matching that effort.

entry.title: Do AI and air traffic control mix? CEO addresses anxiety about new FAA tool
entry.summary: The FAA's ambitious overhaul of the air traffic control system comes amid rising public anxiety about AI. The CEO of the company that's building the software explains how it works.
